reconstruction.scope: Specific existing Stadion Maksimir with four separate native blue stands: tall two-bank west/north, single east and curved low south, yellow access aisles, blue retained athletics apron/sloped west toe, open neutral football pitch/goals. Northern rust-colored service wings/street glazing/native rounded glass stair tower/two western access towers, low western press boxes/canopies, four original-contact lattice floodlight towers and supported neutral southern display retain the asymmetric open skyline. No continuous bowl or speculative stadium roof. No copied seat lettering, crests, sponsor art, crowds or private textures. Separate training facilities/utilities/streets/park and lakes remain native. Proposed replacement is excluded; club states east stand closed since2020 earthquake, so no spectator-access or operation claim.
